artworks.title: Saint Paschal Baylon in Ecstasy
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person levitating, surrounded by swirling lines. The person has their arms outstretched and head tilted upwards. They have soft facial features, rounded cheeks, and short hair. They wear a flowing robe with a belt and a rosary. In the background, two smaller figures are observing, one standing with hands near their chest and the other kneeling with arms raised. Above the central figure, there is an ornate object resembling a chalice or monstrance surrounded by clouds. The artwork is rendered in a monochrome sepia tone.

artworks.title: Aetas Ferrea (The Iron Age)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The foreground shows mounted figures engaged in a skirmish. In the background, a town or village is under attack, with smoke and fire visible. Various animals like horses and cattle are present. The composition is detailed and intricate, conveying movement and energy. Text at the bottom adds context to the events depicted.

artworks.title: God Appearing to Noah
artworks.artist: School of Marcantonio Raimondi, after Marcantonio Raimondi, after Raphael
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with four people. In the center, a kneeling man holds a child and looks up towards the sky. Beside him, an elderly man holds two children under his arms. On the left, a woman carries a child on her shoulder and holds another child by the hand. The background includes a large wooden door, grass, and stones.

artworks.title: Tomb with Death Standing
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows symmetrical shapes and lines, with a central semi-circular arch framing the scene. The design features an abstract structure resembling a monolith in the center. Two sculptures resembling crouching lions flank the structure. Above the structure, a figure is shown in shadow. The composition evokes the grandeur of an ancient temple or tomb.

artworks.title: Four Male Heads
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts four male figures sitting together. The first figure, on the left, is shown in profile, with curly hair. The second figure, in the center, has a large curly beard and hair. The third figure is turned to the right, showing a focused expression with prominent brows and curls. The fourth figure is in a partially obscured three-quarters view. The figures are drawn in a style that includes hatching lines in the background for texture.

artworks.title: The Prophecy of Basilides
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with black and brown washes over black chalk with traces of red chalk, on two joined sheets of greenish-blue laid paper, squared in red chalk, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund and Gift of Funds from Ann and Matthew Nimetz, and from Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This drawing shows figures in a mythical scene. The central interaction involves robed figures and an angelic being, with others observing or being carried aloft in draped cloths. The background includes clouds, hills, and trees framing the composition. The stillness and grace of the figures, along with detailed rendering and shading, suggest a classical or biblical theme. Tonal variations and cross-hatching create movement and tension, capturing a moment of narrative drama in a serene natural setting.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua (recto); Bust of a Child and Head of an Angel (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) red and black chalk on light brown laid paper
b) red and black chalk on light brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up. The individual's head is tilted back with their face raised upwards, giving a clear view of their profile. They have short hair that follows the shape of the head. The person is wearing a loose-fitting garment with wide sleeves, resembling a robe or habit that is tied at the waist. One arm is bent at the elbow with the hand resting at the chest, while the other arm extends outward, palm up. The background is neutral and unembellished, focusing attention on the figure itself.

artworks.title: Virtues Crowning the Bust of Canova
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Helena E. M. Gunnarsson Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring classical elements and figures around a bust. The central bust of a man is on a tall pedestal, and there are various figures and scenes depicted around it. One figure appears fallen or reclining on the ground holding a laurel wreath, while two clothed figures kneel and hang a garland on the pedestal. To the right, three cloaked figures stand in conversation, with one winged figure pointing towards a temple in the background with classical columns. The style and composition suggest neoclassical influences, with an emphasis on idealized human forms and dramatic poses. The image is rendered in shades of brown, indicating the use of ink or wash techniques for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of the top section of a vertically ribbed cactus in various shades of gray. The cactus has a columnar shape with ridges and grooves, ending in a small elevated peak. It is centrally positioned within a rectangular border, against a plain background with slight shadowing. The edges are bordered by a light-colored frame, with a numeral "1" in the bottom-right corner.

artworks.title: a Equisetum hiemale; b Equisetum maximum; c Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays three vertically oriented cone-shaped sculptures with textured and layered designs in grayscale. The material appears to have a smooth finish with ridges and grooves, possibly indicating a wood or metal medium. Each sculpture tapers towards the top and features stacked or layered sections. The sculptures are presented in a row, suggesting a sense of uniformity or thematic connection between them.

artworks.title: Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two similar sculptural forms positioned side by side. Both are vertically elongated, tapering cylindrical shapes with a ribbed texture. The sculptures resemble tapered columns or towers with multiple tiers. They have a grooved pattern running vertically along their surfaces, and each tier slightly protrudes over the one beneath it. The top of each sculpture narrows into a pointed tip. The sculptures are monochrome in shades of gray, but the specific material is not identifiable. The background of the image is sepia-toned.

artworks.title: Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a circular, ribbed tube-like object with scalloped edges and multiple evenly spaced holes along the top edge. The color palette is monochrome, varying in shades of gray. The object is centrally positioned, symmetrical, and occupies a significant portion of the image. The background is a solid darker gray, contrasting with the lighter color of the object. The image is set against a lighter border with a page number '4' at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a form resembling a cluster of elongated, cylindrical shapes, each topped with rounded, flared ends. The material appears to be stone, indicated by the rough, textured surface visible in the monochrome image. The sculpture is presented in an upward direction, reaching towards the top of the image.

artworks.title: a Equisetum hiemale; b Equisetum arvense
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: On the left side of the image is a vertical, ribbed plant stem with multiple sections and smaller protrusions, while on the right side, there is a cone-shaped, scaly plant element with a distinctive hexagonal pattern. The color palette appears to be grayscale, as the image is in black and white. The stem on the left dominates the left half of the image, extending vertically from the bottom towards the top, while the patterned cone occupies the right half, positioned slightly towards the top of the image.

artworks.title: a Equisetum hiemale; b Hosta japonica; c Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of three wooden architectural elements or carvings. The image is presented in black and white and shows three distinct components laid out horizontally in three rows. The top and bottom elements feature fluted, cylindrical designs with cone-shaped terminations. The middle element has a twisting, unfolding structure resembling a plant or flower bud. The photograph captures the texture and craftsmanship of the wood, showcasing intricate patterns and smooth surfaces.

artworks.title: a Equisetum hiemale; b Rhamnus Purshiana; c Equisetum hiemale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture composed of three distinct sections arranged vertically. The top and bottom sections feature a tapered, conical form with ridged, spiral-like textures. The middle section displays multiple elongated, curved elements that intertwine and overlap. The sculpture is monochromatic, presented in a dark, possibly metallic material, with a gray or black color. The texture appears rough and detailed, indicating intricate craftsmanship. The sculpture pieces are elongated and narrow.

artworks.title: a Callicarpa dichotoma; b Fraxinus ornus; c Cornus pubescens
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: There are three elongated botanical objects resembling plant buds or growths, arranged in separate horizontal panels. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of grey against a neutral background. The top object extends horizontally from left to right with a pointed tip on the left. The middle object also stretches horizontally, with multiple elongated projections coming from a central structure on the left side. The bottom object is aligned horizontally as well, featuring a pointed tip on the left and several smaller projections along its length. Each object is centered within its respective panel.

artworks.title: a Cornus brachypoda; b Cornus pubescens; c Viburnum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a squid-like marine creature. The image is composed of three horizontal sections, each displaying a different part of the creature. The top section shows the head and upper arms with a prominent elongated body. The texture of the body appears smooth with a shiny surface. The middle section showcases a close-up view of the creature's arms or tentacles, highlighting the undulating texture and segmentation. The bottom section focuses on another angle of the tentacles and body, emphasizing the tactile patterns and textures. The monochromatic tone adds a scientific and documentary feel to the photograph.

artworks.title: Callistemma brachiatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, textured object with a fibrous surface, resembling a shell or seed pod. It has arch-like openings around its base. The color palette is grayscale, with shades of black and white creating contrast and highlighting the texture. The object is centrally positioned on the page, surrounded by a smooth, textured surface.

artworks.title: Geum rivale
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a plant structure with ribbed texture and petal-like extensions forming an open bell-like shape. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray. The plant's top is detailed and elevated above a dark base against a lighter background. A faint border surrounds the image, and the number 12 is in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Aesculus parviflora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays three stylized, elongated sculptures with abstract faces on top. The faces have simple features such as round eyes and curved lines resembling smiles. The sculptures appear textured, possibly resembling organic material. They are monochrome in grayscale, with darker shades and lighter highlights. The sculptures are arranged vertically, facing the viewer, showcasing their front details. The design suggests a primitive or tribal aesthetic focusing on minimalist representation and texture.

artworks.title: Acer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three elongated cylindrical forms with horizontal ridges and protruding nodes. The forms have a textured pattern and segmented sections, giving them an organic appearance.

artworks.title: a Cornus Nuttallii; b Cornus Nuttallii; c Cornus florida
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sculpture consisting of three vertical cylindrical forms. Each element has bands and textures along its surface, with the central piece featuring a design resembling an opening bud or leaf on its upper section. The sculpture is a dark, matte color, suggesting it may be made from a dense material like metal or dark wood. The scale and size compared to the frame indicate that the pieces are larger than plant stems, conveying strength and solidity. The contrast against the pale background highlights the details and textures of the sculpture.

artworks.title: a Cornus Nuttallii; b Cornus Nuttallii; c Acer
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of detailed bark and twig segments. The image includes three separate black and white photographs stacked vertically, each showing a close-up view of different twig and branch sections. The top photograph shows a twig with textured wraps and bumps, the middle photograph features a branch with a forked twig extending out, and the bottom photograph displays the pointed end of a branch. The images highlight the natural texture, layering, and form of woody plant material.
